answer: Hardware attestation resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to generate keys in a Trusted Execution Environment and submit a signed quote binding its enclave to a unique fused chip ID. Moving past the ivory tower relic of software tokens, this link stops adversaries from cloning identities across VMs inside one ferrous server rack, forcing them to buy physical silicon dies per identity. However, hardware side-channel leaks can still extract enclave keys and break the safeguard.
